record.question: Both of them are responsible. Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'Both'.
record.explanation: Answer C: pronoun. Both in “both of them” stands as a pronoun (C). Independent check: “Both” stands without a following noun (“both of them”), so traditional classification is pronoun. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/both.
